name: the-hague-appointment-checker
description: A local Playwright checker for possible appointment availability in The Hague.

scripts.check: cross-env APPOINTMENT_MODE=real HEADLESS=true tsx src/index.ts check
scripts.check:simulate: cross-env APPOINTMENT_MODE=simulate-fixed HEADLESS=false tsx src/index.ts check
scripts.monitor:real: cross-env APPOINTMENT_MODE=real HEADLESS=true tsx src/index.ts monitor
scripts.monitor:simulate: cross-env APPOINTMENT_MODE=simulate-timeline HEADLESS=true tsx src/index.ts monitor
scripts.debug: cross-env APPOINTMENT_MODE=real HEADLESS=false DEBUG_SLOW_MODE=false DEBUG_SCREENSHOTS=true tsx src/index.ts check
scripts.debug:slow: cross-env APPOINTMENT_MODE=real DEBUG_SLOW_MODE=true HEADLESS=false DEBUG_SCREENSHOTS=true tsx src/index.ts check
scripts.debug:foreign-documents: cross-env APPOINTMENT_MODE=real HEADLESS=false DEBUG_SCREENSHOTS=true tsx src/debug-service.ts
